name: Envelope Collection Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    Made from natural wood, this card features fine laser-cut details with smooth, sanded surfaces. The wooden structure is layered for durability, with a 3mm wood sheet base and a finished total thickness of approximately 12mm. Comes with a natural sedge rope for optional hanging.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    Available in two formats compatible with A6 and A7 envelopes:
    A7 Wooden Plaque Size: 12.7 × 12.7 cm ~ 5 × 5 inches
    A6 Wooden Plaque Size: 17.8 × 17.8 cm ~ 7 × 7 inches
    White Card Inserts (included):
    A7 Insert: 8.8 × 5.7 cm ~ 3.46 × 2.24 inches
    A6 Insert: 13 × 8.7 cm ~ 5.12 × 3.42 inches
    Envelope Sizes (in 3 colors: light khaki, white, black):
    A7 Envelope: 10.5 × 7 cm ~ 4.13 × 2.76 inches
    A6 Envelope: 15.4 × 10.6 cm ~ 6.06 × 4.17 inches

 

  • Printing Technology:
    UV printing is applied on both sides of the wooden card, resulting in high-resolution, full-color graphics with excellent clarity and durability. Text and design elements are customizable for various messages and occasions.

 

  • Functional Use:
    This product is more than a card – it's a miniature envelope display box, great for sending messages, invitations, announcements, or personal notes. The cut-out design and hanging hole also allow it to serve as home décor, keepsakes, or desk ornaments.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    Ideal as a meaningful and versatile gift for weddings, farewells, graduations, anniversaries, birthdays, or holidays. Its personalized design and premium finish make it a memorable keepsake anyone would cherish.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Envelope Collection Box

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
